header.running_head: The Incident of Hadhrat Jaabir Bin Abdullaah (RA) in this Regard

A narration of Abu Ya'la says that Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) said, "I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ says, 'Whenever the feet of a servant (of Allaah) gets dusty in the path of Allaah, Allaah forbids Jahannam from them'." It was then that Hadhrat Maalik (RA) and the other people dismounted form their animals and more people were not see walking as on that day.[^2]
Serving Others While Out in the Path of Allaah
Those who Were not Fasting Serve the Fasting Ones in the path of Allaah

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that on a certain expedition with Rasulullaah ﷺ, some of them were fasting while others were not. When they stopped to set up camp, the heat was extreme and those with the most shade were those with shawls (who used their shawls to shade themselves). Others used their hands to shield themselves from the blazing sun. Those who were fasting fell to the ground while those who were not fasting stood up to pitch the tents and water the animals. Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "Today those who are not fasting have taken all the rewards."[^3]

A narration of Bukhari states that those with the most shade with Rasulullaah ﷺ were those who used their shawls to shade themselves. Whereas the fasting ones could do nothing, those who were not fasting sent the animals (for watering), exerted themselves to serve and did other tedious tasks. Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "Today those who are not fasting have taken all the rewards."
The Sahabah (RA) Serve a Man Engrossed in Reciting the Qur'aan and Performing Salaah

Hadhrat Abu Qilaaba (RA) narrates that after returning from a journey, the Sahabah (RA) were full of praise for one of their companions. They said, "We have not seen anyone like him. Whenever we traveled, he was busy reciting the Qur'aan and whenever we set up camp, he was engaged in salaah." Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "Who did his errands for him?" Asking about several things, Rasulullaah ﷺ also asked, "Who used to feed his animal?" When the others replied that they had been doing this, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Then all of you are better than him (because you have gained all his rewards by serving him)."[^4]
